title: Fractus-II: One Shape, Folded at Every Depth
description: A thought experiment on how a single folded geometry might give rise to forces, matter, spin, light, gravity, and the dark universe. It is a thought experiment, not a finished theory. Fractus-II is the second work in the series, following Fractus (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23457481). This version adds an audio reading of the full text (fractus-ii.mp3, about 2 h 32 min). Read the manuscript at https://ridleydisiena.github.io/fractus-ii/
